title: Keep overflowing view options menus scrollable
answers: How do I keep long content-view menus usable?
Where is the content-view dropdown positioned?
body:
Symptom: The view options menu overflows when its list becomes too tall.
Root cause: The dropdown used by web/src/js/components/contentviews/ViewSelector.tsx:ViewSelector lacked a menu height limit and vertical scrolling.
Fix pattern: Bound dropdown menu height and enable vertical scrolling; this fix uses max-height: 250px and overflow-y: scroll. ViewSelector also uses top-end placement.
Constraints: The height and scrolling treatment lives in shared dropdown styling; the top-end placement is configured specifically in ViewSelector. This pattern addresses menu overflow, not option selection behavior.
applies: Content-view selector layout and dropdown menus with long option lists.
